agent_note: First-person present-tense narration; the present event quotes report specific moments as they happen ('He kisses me until my head empties', 'Something in my chest tightens', 'I go to bed'). All four past event quotes are a recollection/backstory strand - a mother's told wisdom, a mother's dreams, a woman who 'locked herself like a prison', and the narrator's own 'One day, I woke up'. Two of those four (q10639, q10646) are internally mixed, pairing a past clause with a present-tense coda, and would push the split to 10/2 present if read the other way. Heavy dialogue and aphorism yield here is typical of the source's quotability bias; gnomic applied only to present-tense generalizations beyond the story world.
